purpose: Gate HUNT market availability on reviewed legal, returns, shipping, identity and cancellation evidence without auto-generating or auto-publishing legal text.
canonical_dependencies: hunt_legal_document_versions (branch migration; not deployed to Production at audit time)

requirements: distance-sale disclosure includes business identity, principal characteristics, price/payment terms and cancellation method
14-day remote-sale cancellation baseline handled with category/exemption rules reviewed by counsel
prominent online cancellation route available where online contracting is available
refund/return fee rules and protected-consumer extended rights configured only after counsel review
14-day withdrawal baseline for distance goods subject to exceptions
withdrawal information and standard process disclosed before purchase
easy-to-find online withdrawal function continuously available during withdrawal period
durable-medium acknowledgement after online withdrawal submission
seller identity, price and shipping/delivery information disclosed
14 days to notify cancellation after receipt for online goods, subject to exceptions
another 14 days for return after cancellation notice
refund timing and standard-delivery refund rules reflected in policy
delivery within 30 days unless another period is agreed
shipping promises have reasonable basis
if no shipment time is stated, 30-day default rule is handled
delay notice obtains consent or cancellation/refund as required
refund workflow can promptly return unshipped-order funds
returns policy does not waive Australian Consumer Law guarantees
major-problem refund/replacement rights are preserved
minor-problem remedy rules are not replaced by a blanket no-refunds term
change-of-mind policy, if offered, is clearly distinguished from statutory guarantees

unmapped_market_policy.rule: Any country/territory not explicitly mapped and reviewed remains unavailable for real-money launch until its consumer, privacy, tax/import and shipping obligations are reviewed.

shipping_truth_rules: Never advertise a delivery promise shorter than the verified supplier/logistics estimate.
Country-specific delivery promise must be derived from current quote evidence, not a static marketing claim.
Customs, duties, taxes and import-responsibility wording must be market-reviewed before checkout.
If delivery evidence becomes stale or unavailable, checkout must degrade to HOLD/RECHECK rather than invent an ETA.
returns_truth_rules: Statutory consumer remedies override narrower voluntary store policies where applicable.
Category exceptions (for example hygiene/perishable/personalized goods) must be explicitly mapped before use.
Return cost responsibility must be disclosed before purchase where required.
Refund timing must be market-specific and evidence-backed.
No blanket 'no refunds' wording may override statutory rights.
publication_rules: No legal document becomes public unless owner_approved=true, status=published, effective_at is active and body content is non-empty.
Legal content is owner/counsel supplied; BOOM may flag gaps but does not create binding production legal text autonomously.
Market readiness may never be inferred from the existence of a legal page shell.
Any legal-source change or market expansion reopens review.
